besluit.doel: For example: my team understands why this decision was made and what it means for their daily work.
besluit.boodschap: For example: this decision is final; together we will look at how to make it land well.
besluit.punt: For example: what concretely changes and from when

draagvlak.doel: For example: my team backs the approach and wants to help shape how we carry it out.
draagvlak.boodschap: For example: I believe in this approach and I need you to make it work.
draagvlak.punt: For example: which problem this solves

motiveren.doel: For example: my employee feels seen and has fresh energy for the next step.
motiveren.boodschap: For example: I see what you contribute and I believe in your next step.
motiveren.punt: For example: a concrete example of what is going well

lastig.doel: For example: the message has come across clearly and we have a follow-up meeting.
lastig.boodschap: For example: I need to tell you something difficult, and I want to discuss it together.
lastig.punt: For example: the heart of the message, without padding

mail.onderwerp: Your conversation blueprint{gespreksMet|voor: for your conversation with }
mail.intro:
Hi{gespreksNaam|voor: },

Here is the blueprint for your conversation{gespreksMet|voor: with }{gespreksDatum|voor: on }.

How to use it:
- Read it through once more, five minutes before the conversation.
- During or after the conversation, tick off your key points and note any agreements in the notes box.
- Is the conversation drifting outside the boundaries? Name it, park it, and return to your core message.
